task_a: Preserve Authorization headers for loopback HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects.
task_b: Treat localhost and 127.0.0.1 as same-origin aliases when scheme and port match.
merge_result: Patch A and Patch B apply cleanly to the same base commit with git apply; no textual conflict is reported.
failure_summary: Patch A preserves Authorization on loopback HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects. Patch B treats localhost and 127.0.0.1 as same-origin aliases for matching scheme and port. Together, the composed client preserves Authorization across both a scheme change and host-alias change, violating the redirect credential-forwarding policy encoded by the composition oracle.
notes: First security-policy seed. It tests how two individually plausible redirect relaxations compose into an overly broad credential-forwarding rule.
